items.title: A Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering Framework with Automated Cluster Cardinality Estimation Ability
items.titleZh: 具有自动聚类基数估计能力的广义稀疏模糊聚类框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00159v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Fuzzy clustering provides a robust framework for handling ambiguous and overlapping data boundaries, yet its traditional formulation generates entirely dense membership assignments that limit noise resilience and prevent estimating the true number of clusters, when it is unknown. To address these limitations, we introduce in this paper the Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering (GSFC) framework, which incorporates a continuous sparsity penalty into the fuzzy objective function. Because closed-form solutions are precluded by the simultaneous presence of fuzzifier and sparsity exponents, we propose an efficient primal-dual bisection search coupled with specialized analytic pathways to rigorously enforce the partition constraint while organically driving trace memberships to exact zero. This mathematically enforced sparsity empowers the algorithm to autonomously estimate the true number of clusters by dynamically pruning redundant clusters, provided that it is initialized by a larger than the true number of clusters. Furthermore, we integrate a virtual noise sink to insulate outliers from the rest of the data points. The usage of the proposed framework is also extended to line segment detection. Extensive empirical evaluations across synthetic toy datasets, high-noise geometric stress tests, and real-world benchmarks (UCI wine dataset and hyperspectral images) demonstrate that GSFC effectively exceeds conventional fuzzy benchmarks while autonomously resolving cluster cardinality. Additionally, it significantly outperforms existing sparse possibilistic and probabilistic soft-clustering alternatives in line detection tasks.

arXiv:2611.00159v1 公告类型：新
摘要：模糊聚类为处理不明确和重叠的数据边界提供了一个强大的框架，但其传统的公式会生成完全密集的成员资格分配，从而限制了噪声弹性并在未知时无法估计聚类的真实数量。为了解决这些限制，我们在本文中引入了广义稀疏模糊聚类（GSFC）框架，该框架将连续稀疏性惩罚合并到模糊目标函数中。由于模糊器和稀疏指数的同时存在排除了封闭形式的解决方案，因此我们提出了一种有效的原对偶二分搜索与专门的分析路径相结合，以严格执行分区约束，同时有机地将跟踪成员资格驱动到精确的零。这种数学上强制的稀疏性使算法能够通过动态修剪冗余簇来自主估计簇的真实数量，前提是它是由大于真实簇数的簇初始化的。此外，我们集成了一个虚拟噪声接收器，以将异常值与其余数据点隔离。所提出的框架的使用也扩展到线段检测。对合成玩具数据集、高噪声几何压力测试和现实世界基准（UCI 葡萄酒数据集和高光谱图像）进行的广泛实证评估表明，GSFC 在自主解析集群基数的同时有效地超越了传统的模糊基准。此外，它在线路检测任务中显着优于现有的稀疏可能性和概率软聚类替代方案。

items.title: Learning to bid and bundle: a posterior-sampling agent for online retail
items.titleZh: 学习投标和捆绑：在线零售的后采样代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00165v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: An online retailer launching a perishable product bids for sponsored-search clicks, discounts a bundle with an always-stocked staple and displays its remaining stock, which raises willingness to pay. It knows neither how clicks respond to its bid nor how strong and dispersed its market is, and learns both over repeated seasons from data its own decisions censor: a zero bid reveals nothing about paid clicks, and choices follow only clicks. We design a posterior-sampling agent for it. Each period it draws a market from an exact posterior and posts the bid and discount of that market's exactly solved season plan, so every action is one a fully informed seller could take. In a simulated online florist it has the lowest regret averaged over markets. In weak markets it gives up 12% to 23% of one season's revenue over 500 seasons, four to seven times less than drawing once per season. A planner acting on point estimates can stop bidding and never learn that bidding pays. The agent escapes after about three seasons on average, against fifty with one draw per season. Where displayed scarcity keeps willingness to pay above the posted price, the discount needs no learning. Customers waiting for the discount to return to its recent level look like lost sales, so frequent waiting makes the agent underrate its market. One discount per season removes waiting at a cost of 5.9% of clairvoyant revenue in a weak market and none in a strong one.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00165v1 公告类型：新
摘要：一家在线零售商推出了一种易腐烂的产品，竞价赞助搜索点击，对包含常备库存的主食捆绑包进行折扣，并显示其剩余库存，从而提高了支付意愿。它既不知道点击量对其出价有何反应，也不知道其市场有多强大和分散，并且通过自己的决策审查员的数据在重复的季节中学习：零出价不会透露任何有关付费点击的信息，并且选择仅跟随点击。我们为其设计了一个后采样代理。每个时期它都会从精确的后验中抽取一个市场，并发布该市场精确解决的季节计划的出价和折扣，因此每一项行动都是完全知情的卖家可以采取的行动。在模拟的在线花店中，它的市场平均后悔率最低。在市场疲软的情况下，它会在 500 个赛季中放弃一个赛季收入的 12% 到 23%，比每个赛季抽签一次的收入少四到七倍。根据点估计行事的规划者可能会停止投标，并且永远不会知道投标是有回报的。这位特工平均在三个赛季后就逃脱了，而每个赛季有五十个赛季只有一场平局。如果显示出的稀缺性使支付意愿高于标明的价格，则无需学习折扣。等待折扣恢复到最近水平的客户看起来就像失去了销售，因此频繁的等待会让代理商低估其市场。在疲软的市场中，每季一次折扣可以消除等待，成本为预知收入的 5.9%，而在强劲的市场中则不会。

items.title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
items.titleZh: 大型推理模型中的早期停止：效率和可靠性的调查和实证审计
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00166v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also reveal continued reasoning after forced termination and weaker supporting reasoning in some correct early-stopping outputs. The implementation can be found in https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stopping.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00166v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型推理模型可以通过生成更长的推理轨迹来提高准确性，但其中一些计算可能是不必要的。早期停止方法的目的是在有足够的推理可供回答时停止。评估这些方法需要考虑决定何时停止的成本以及结果答案的可靠性。我们通过使用共享的转出重播协议来评估关于数学和科学推理、代码生成和事实性任务的五个推理模型的不同方法。我们引入目标集成代币效率（TITE）来衡量相对于预言机在准确度目标上的效率。我们还检查后来退出位置的正确性、跨模型和任务的转移、停止后推理的延续以及保留的理由质量。在我们的实验中，在超出拟合解码噪声模型预测的位置之后，正确性可能会降低。可靠性检查还揭示了强制终止后的继续推理以及某些正确的早期停止输出中较弱的支持推理。可以在 https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stopping 中找到实现。

items.title: PatchScout: Thematic Web Data Collection via Information Foraging
items.titleZh: PatchScout：通过信息搜集进行专题 Web 数据收集
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00169v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Researchers often need web corpora that are not answers to a single query, but reusable collections of documents spanning many decentralized sources. We refer to this problem as thematic web data collection: assembling semantically relevant documents that share a common theme but are scattered across heterogeneous and structurally disconnected regions of the web. Existing approaches, including traversal-based methods and LLM-driven web agents, are limited by local exploration or short-horizon stopping, preventing comprehensive collection. We formulate this task as a long-horizon information foraging problem over query-induced semantic patches, where the central challenge is deciding when to continue local exploitation and when to switch to new regions. We propose PatchScout, a multi-agent framework that instantiates a class of patch-switching policies to balance local exploitation and adaptive patch switching under a fixed budget. Experiments on four live-web topics show that PatchScout substantially improves yield and domain coverage over traversal-based and search-augmented reasoning agent baselines. In an applied social science setting with an incomplete prior collection, PatchScout discovers 102 previously unidentified entities, illustrating its ability to expand existing thematic datasets.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00169v1 公告类型：新
摘要：研究人员通常需要的网络语料库不是单个查询的答案，而是跨越许多分散来源的可重复使用的文档集合。我们将此问题称为主题网络数据收集：组装语义相关的文档，这些文档共享一个共同的主题，但分散在网络的异构和结构不连贯的区域中。现有的方法，包括基于遍历的方法和 LLM 驱动的网络代理，都受到局部探索或短期停止的限制，无法进行全面收集。我们将此任务表述为查询引起的语义补丁上的长期信息搜寻问题，其中的核心挑战是决定何时继续本地开发以及何时切换到新区域。我们提出了 PatchScout，一个多代理框架，它实例化了一类补丁切换策略，以在固定预算下平衡本地开发和自适应补丁切换。对四个实时网络主题的实验表明，与基于遍历和搜索增强的推理代理基线相比，PatchScout 显着提高了产量和领域覆盖率。在先前收集不完整的应用社会科学环境中，PatchScout 发现了 102 个先前未识别的实体，说明了其扩展现有主题数据集的能力。

items.title: Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies
items.titleZh: 重新构想文本到 SQL：大型语言模型架构和策略的调查
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00171v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. Early approaches relied on handcrafted rules and template matching, while subsequent neural methods introduced encoder-decoder architectures, schema linking, and constrained decoding to handle increasingly complex queries. The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD. In parallel, modular frameworks decompose the task into sub-problems (schema retrieval, sketch-based generation, repair, and ranking), while agentic systems coordinate multiple specialized agents that communicate and dynamically allocate sub-tasks. This survey systematically reviews these LLM-driven approaches within a unified taxonomy of five paradigms (in-context learning, supervised and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic and tool-augmented orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning) and characterizes them by model granularity (monolithic vs. modular), level of supervision (zero-shot, fine-tuned, or reinforcement-based), and reasoning style (direct decoding vs. decomposed multi-step reasoning). We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems. As LLMs increasingly access sensitive databases, we also discuss responsible AI practices. We survey over 100 papers and technical resources, focusing on work published between 2022 and 2026.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00171v1 公告类型：新
摘要：文本到 SQL 系统将自然语言问题转换为可执行的 SQL 查询，从而实现对关系数据的访问民主化。早期的方法依赖于手工规则和模板匹配，而随后的神经方法引入了编码器-解码器架构、模式链接和约束解码来处理日益复杂的查询。以 ReFoRCE、Agentar-Scale-SQL、Snowflake 的 Arctic-Text2SQL-R1 和模块化 XiYan-SQL 框架等系统为代表的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的出现极大地推进了该领域的发展，将在 Spider、Spider 2.0 和 BIRD 等具有挑战性的基准测试中的执行精度推向了新的最先进水平。同时，模块化框架将任务分解为子问题（模式检索、基于草图的生成、修复和排名），而代理系统则协调多个专门代理进行通信并动态分配子任务。这项调查在五种范式（上下文学习、监督和参数高效微调、代理和工具增强编排、检索增强生成和强化学习）的统一分类中系统地回顾了这些法学硕士驱动的方法，并通过模型粒度（整体与模块化）、监督级别（零样本、微调或基于强化）和推理风格（直接解码与分解多步）来表征它们推理）。我们进一步分析评估指标、数据集和开放挑战，包括领域泛化、效率和实际部署，并研究语义层在生产系统中的作用。随着法学硕士越来越多地访问敏感数据库，我们也讨论了负责任的人工智能实践。我们调查了 100 多篇论文和技术资源，重点关注 2022 年至 2026 年期间发表的工作。

items.title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
items.titleZh: AuroraWorld：用于机器人操作中的 Exo-to-Ego 视频生成的结构化 4D 世界建模
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00177v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.

arXiv:2611.00177v1 公告类型：新
摘要：以自我为中心的观察提供了以机器人为中心的操作过程视图，捕捉接触交互和物体状态变化，这对于视觉运动策略学习很重要，但很难从外部摄像头观察到。然而，由于额外的硬件要求和特定于平台的部署成本，大规模收集此类数据仍然昂贵。从大规模外心操纵视频中综合以自我为中心的观察结果提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。然而，现有的方法很难在大量的视点变换、严重的遮挡、复杂的对象交互以及来自可用的外心视点的固有稀疏观察的情况下合成物理一致且与政策相关的以自我为中心的视频。
items.author: Hao Xue, Peng-Fei Zhang, Ying Cheng, Lanyun Zhu, Lei Zhu, Heng Tao Shen

items.title: Neurons Are All You Need
items.titleZh: 神经元就是你所需要的
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00186v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: For decades, artificial neural networks have operated under the assumption that durable, learned capability resides exclusively in adaptive synaptic parameters, primarily due to the established neurobiology of synaptic connectivity. This design forces models to remain stateless during deployment, incurring well-known limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and expensive retraining. However, recent neurobiological research by Glanzman and colleagues, and others, shows that memories can be transferred between individual organisms in a synaptically independent manner. Inspired by this research, we sought to demonstrate memory transfer of persistent memory between AI model instances, leveraging a neurocentric version of memory. In this paper, we propose NURESA (Neural Unit with Retentive Self-Adaptive Architecture), a novel neural layer that eschews sole reliance on synaptic weight updating by introducing persistent intra-unit memory as a first-class, computational primitive. By structurally separating computation from persistent memory, NURESA enables autonomous memory accumulation and consolidation into transferable stores of memory registers. Experiments across MLP, GPT-2, and modern frontier models like Qwen2.5 demonstrate qualitatively new capability: zero-shot transfer of learned capability into a naive model instance without retraining or access to the original training data; this transfer is enabled by a sparse set of parameters in NURESA's memory register that the model selects on its own based on which neurons were most active. The memory transfer capability of NURESA also protects against domain loss when transformer models undergo learning via fine-tuning. Finally, the memory transfer process completes in approximately one minute even for transformer models with millions to billions of parameters, producing a transfer file orders of magnitude smaller than the original model.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00186v1 公告类型：新
摘要：几十年来，人工神经网络一直在这样的假设下运行：持久的学习能力完全取决于自适应突触参数，这主要是由于已建立的突触连接神经生物学。这种设计迫使模型在部署过程中保持无状态，从而导致众所周知的限制，例如灾难性遗忘和昂贵的重新训练。然而，格兰兹曼及其同事和其他人最近的神经生物学研究表明，记忆可以以突触独立的方式在个体生物体之间转移。受这项研究的启发，我们试图利用神经中心版本的记忆来演示人工智能模型实例之间持久记忆的记忆转移。在本文中，我们提出了 NURESA（具有保持性自适应架构的神经单元），这是一种新颖的神经层，通过引入持久的单元内内存作为一流的计算原语，避免了对突触权重更新的唯一依赖。通过在结构上将计算与持久内存分离，NURESA 能够实现自主内存积累和整合到内存寄存器的可转移存储中。跨 MLP、GPT-2 和现代前沿模型（如 Qwen2.5）的实验展示了全新的能力：将学习到的能力零样本转移到朴素模型实例中，无需重新训练或访问原始训练数据；这种传输是通过 NURESA 内存寄存器中的一组稀疏参数来实现的，模型根据哪些神经元最活跃来自行选择这些参数。当变压器模型通过微调进行学习时，NURESA 的内存传输功能还可以防止域丢失。最后，即使对于具有数百万到数十亿参数的变压器模型，内存传输过程也会在大约一分钟内完成，从而生成比原始模型小几个数量级的传输文件。

items.title: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
items.titleZh: MemU-Bench：长期用户交互上的 GUI 代理基准测试
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00191v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) benchmarks predominantly rely on precise and stateless user instructions. In everyday usage, however, instructions are often \emph{vague and history-dependent}: users omit the exact details of their past operations because they no longer remember them, leaving the agent to recover the missing context from long and noisy interaction histories. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce \textbf{MemU-Bench}, a mobile benchmark of \textbf{118 vague tasks} grounded in 29 long-horizon user trajectories, where agents must distill raw interaction streams into memory and retrieve the missing context on demand, with task outcomes verified against serialized application databases. Alongside Success Rate, we incorporate Interaction Efficiency (IE) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) to expose agents that succeed by exhaustively searching across different applications rather than by \emph{genuinely recalling} the history. Evaluations show that without user history, state-of-the-art systems struggle under such ambiguity: the best-performing Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves an SPL of only 16.4\%, and end-to-end GUI agents fall below 5\%. To address this, we further propose \textbf{AppMem}, a training-free framework that distills user history into a \emph{structured, app-centric} memory bank, tracks interrupted intents across application switches, and selectively retrieves relevant memories via target-app inference. AppMem raises the SPL of GPT-5.5 from 15.7\% to 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%}), outperforms a naive summary baseline by 9.3\%, and delivers consistent gains across evaluated backbones.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00191v1 公告类型：新
摘要：现有的图形用户界面（GUI）基准主要依赖于精确和无状态的用户指令。然而，在日常使用中，指令通常是\emph{模糊且依赖于历史}：用户省略了过去操作的确切细节，因为他们不再记得它们，让代理从漫长而嘈杂的交互历史中恢复丢失的上下文。为了弥补这一评估差距，我们引入了 \textbf{MemU-Bench}，这是一个基于 29 个长期用户轨迹的 \textbf{118 个模糊任务}的移动基准，其中代理必须将原始交互流提取到内存中并按需检索丢失的上下文，并根据序列化应用程序数据库验证任务结果。除了成功率之外，我们还结合了交互效率 (IE) 和按路径长度加权的成功 (SPL)，以揭示通过详尽搜索不同应用程序而不是通过\emph{真正回忆}历史来成功的代理。评估表明，如果没有用户历史记录，最先进的系统就会在这种模糊性下挣扎：性能最好的 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 SPL 仅为 16.4%，而端到端 GUI 代理则低于 5%。为了解决这个问题，我们进一步提出了 \textbf{AppMem}，这是一个免训练的框架，它将用户历史记录提取到 \emph{结构化的、以应用程序为中心的}内存库中，跟踪应用程序切换中中断的意图，并通过目标应用程序推理选择性地检索相关内存。 AppMem 将 GPT-5.5 的 SPL 从 15.7\% 提高到 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%})，比简单的摘要基线高 9.3\%，并在评估的骨干网中提供一致的增益。

items.titleZh: 从横截面到跨组学：空间转录组学中的条件细胞核图像编辑
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00226v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) platforms simultaneously measure gene expression and capture cell nucleus images at single-cell resolution. A fundamental property of tissue preparation introduces a confounding relationship between the two measurement modalities: sectioning a three-dimensional tissue into a thin slice produces a two-dimensional cross-section whose area depends on the cutting angle. Larger cross-sections expose more cytoplasm, yielding higher mRNA counts, while pathomics features such as nuclear area are measured directly from the same 2D boundary. This sectioning geometry creates an apparent correlation between gene expression and pathomics that reflects the measurement process rather than independent biology. Existing gene-to-image methods generate cell images from gene features but do not support condition-driven editing of existing images across both omics layers. We apply the Manifold-Aware Diffusion (MAD) framework to this dual-omics editing setting, enabling targeted modification of one feature group while preserving the other. Evaluated on podocyte cells from CosMx SMI kidney tissue, MAD achieves MAE=0.6636 and FID=25.19 for pathomics editing, outperforming all compared baselines. A controlled simulation study further confirms that the VAE component in MAD better preserves cross-group independence than CCDM (MAD without VAE).
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00226v1 公告类型：新
摘要：空间转录组学 (ST) 平台可同时测量基因表达并以单细胞分辨率捕获细胞核图像。组织制备的一个基本特性引入了两种测量模式之间的混杂关系：将三维组织切成薄片会产生二维横截面，其面积取决于切割角度。更大的横截面暴露更多的细胞质，产生更高的 mRNA 计数，而核面积等病理学特征可以直接从相同的 2D 边界测量。这种切片几何形状在基因表达和病理组学之间建立了明显的相关性，反映了测量过程而不是独立的生物学。现有的基因到图像方法根据基因特征生成细胞图像，但不支持跨两个组学层对现有图像进行条件驱动的编辑。我们将流形感知扩散（MAD）框架应用于这种双组学编辑设置，从而能够有针对性地修改一个特征组，同时保留另一个特征组。对来自 CosMx SMI 肾组织的足细胞进行评估，MAD 的病理组学编辑达到 MAE=0.6636 和 FID=25.19，优于所有比较的基线。受控模拟研究进一步证实，MAD 中的 VAE 组件比 CCDM（没有 VAE 的 MAD）更好地保持了跨组独立性。

items.title: RE-SciVQA: Improving Scientific VQA With Context-Relevant Retrieval and Lightweight MLLM Adaptation
items.titleZh: RE-SciVQA：通过上下文相关检索和轻量级 MLLM 适应改进科学 VQA
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00242v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A deep understanding of scientific literature often relies on interpreting figures that contain key information beyond the main text. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract insights from these figures can significantly accelerate knowledge discovery. Existing works on Scientific Visual Question Answering rely on resource-intensive training pipelines that are often inaccessible and require large computational resources. Instead of designing complex architectures, we propose RE- SciVQA, which focuses on improving the quality of retrieved context and fine-tuning small LLMs with parameter-efficient LoRA training. Using a simple query expansion step, relevant section headers are appended to the original question to improve the retrieval coverage. In addition, a simple adjustment of similarity scores is applied using figure references and caption alignment. On the SciVQA benchmark, RE-SciVQA achieves a ROUGE-1 F1 score of 73.9%, outperforming chart-focused models such as UniChart (14.7%), ChartGemma (6.9%), and Matcha-ChartQA (6.3%). Our relevance-enhanced RAG setup also improves the exact match by 11.9% and the fuzzy match by 29.5% compared with a standard RAG baseline, resulting in an overall gain of 14.3%. We also examine closed-ended infinite visual questions, a category in which chart-understanding models often struggle. Our experiments show that using plot digitization instead of synthetic captions leads to an 18.5% improvement for this question type.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00242v1 公告类型：新
摘要：对科学文献的深入理解通常依赖于对包含正文之外的关键信息的图表的解释。利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 从这些数据中提取见解可以显着加速知识发现。科学视觉问答的现有工作依赖于资源密集型训练管道，这些管道通常无法访问并且需要大量计算资源。我们提出 RE-SciVQA，而不是设计复杂的架构，它专注于提高检索上下文的质量，并通过参数高效的 LoRA 训练微调小型 LLM。使用简单的查询扩展步骤，将相关部分标题附加到原始问题以提高检索覆盖率。此外，还使用图形参考和标题对齐对相似性分数进行简单调整。在 SciVQA 基准上，RE-SciVQA 的 ROUGE-1 F1 得分为 73.9%，优于 UniChart (14.7%)、ChartGemma (6.9%) 和 Matcha-ChartQA (6.3%) 等图表模型。与标准 RAG 基线相比，我们的相关性增强 RAG 设置还将精确匹配提高了 11.9%，模糊匹配提高了 29.5%，总体增益提高了 14.3%。我们还研究了封闭式无限视觉问题，这是图表理解模型经常遇到困难的一类问题。我们的实验表明，使用绘图数字化而不是合成标题可以使该问题类型提高 18.5%。

items.title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
items.titleZh: OmniPiano：针对标准、稳健、安全和多智能体 RL 的多样化灵巧钢琴演奏挑战
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00243v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Dexterous robotic manipulation remains a major challenge in robotics, exemplified by piano playing, which requires coordinated control of fingers and provides a demanding testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). Although previous work established a benchmark for robotic piano playing, it is restricted to two hands and does not support unified evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce OmniPiano, a benchmark that provides one to up to five Shadow Hands and supports standard, robust, safe, and multi-agent RL within a shared piano-playing task family. OmniPiano is developed for scalable and diverse piano-playing tasks with configurable perturbations, explicit safety constraints, and decentralized cooperation settings. Particularly, to facilitate usability and extendability, OmniPiano adopts a highly modular design and provides comprehensive tasks to support RL study of task performance, robustness, safety, and cooperation in dexterous control. With at least 912 task settings and 36 baseline algorithms, OmniPiano further incorporates LLM-based agents to broaden the evaluation scope and reveal new insights. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art RL algorithms and frontier LLM-based agents still struggle on challenging piano-playing tasks, even under standard RL settings, highlighting substantial room for improvement in dexterous control. The code, dataset, tutorial, and demo are available at https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00243v1 公告类型：新
摘要：灵巧的机器人操作仍然是机器人技术中的一个主要挑战，以钢琴演奏为例，它需要手指的协调控制，并为强化学习（RL）提供了苛刻的测试平台。虽然之前的工作为机器人钢琴演奏建立了基准，但它仅限于两只手，并且不支持统一评估。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 OmniPiano，这是一个基准测试，可提供一到五个 Shadow Hands，并在共享钢琴演奏任务系列中支持标准、稳健、安全和多代理 RL。 OmniPiano 专为可扩展和多样化的钢琴演奏任务而开发，具有可配置的扰动、明确的安全约束和分散的合作设置。特别是，为了提高可用性和可扩展性，OmniPiano 采用高度模块化的设计，并提供全面的任务来支持任务性能、鲁棒性、安全性和灵巧控制协作的 RL 研究。 OmniPiano 拥有至少 912 个任务设置和 36 个基线算法，进一步整合了基于 LLM 的代理，以扩大评估范围并揭示新的见解。广泛的评估表明，即使在标准 RL 设置下，最先进的 RL 算法和基于前沿 LLM 的代理仍然难以完成具有挑战性的钢琴演奏任务，这凸显了灵巧控制方面的巨大改进空间。代码、数据集、教程和演示可在 https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/ 获取。

items.title: Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost
items.titleZh: Taurus：LLM 在环 CT 注释以一半的成本匹配编码代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00247v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents did well into the automated pass then carried most of the gain on 38 held-out cases. The final version smooths the label surfaces with a fixed rule and checks for the large errors the automated pass tends to make, such as an aneurysm drawn to half its size. Each check that fires puts a multiple-choice question to the model, with candidate corrections drawn on the scan. It matched the surface smoothness of the human references, and in the primary metric we found no difference from the free-form Opus agent, at under half its cost, $1.22 against $2.71 per case. Most of what made Taurus competitive came from the harness and its automation rather than from the language model itself. Taurus shows that this kind of annotation can be automated, so that expert time can move from drawing labels to checking them.

arXiv:2611.00247v1 公告类型：新
摘要：CT 中主动脉的密集标签绘制起来很慢，并且可以代替它们的公共主动脉 CT 数据集各自根据自己的惯例标记不同的结构。大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理现在可以编写代码和读取图像。我们询问这样的模型是否可以作为编写自己的分段代码的自由形式代理更好地标记这些扫描，或者在安全带中更好地标记这些扫描，其中自动传递标记扫描并且模型审查结果。我们构建了一个工具 Taurus，并通过盲标签恢复将其与自由形式代理进行比较：我们保留了六个公共数据集（939 卷）的人类标签，并根据每个数据集自己的类别对每种方法进行评分。在 Taurus 的第一个版本中，模型的审查仅提高了六个数据集中两个数据集的主要指标，其提高幅度小于同一案例的两次审查之间的噪音。运行 Claude Opus 5.5 的自由形式代理在大多数数据集上得分更高。将自由形式代理的出色表现转移到自动传递中，然后在 38 个保留案例中获得大部分收益。最终版本使用固定规则平滑标签表面，并检查自动传递容易产生的大错误，例如将动脉瘤绘制到其一半大小。每次触发的检查都会向模型提出多项选择题，并在扫描中绘制候选更正。它与人类参考的表面光滑度相匹配，在主要指标中，我们发现与自由形式 Opus 代理没有任何区别，成本不到其一半，每箱 1.22 美元，而每箱 2.71 美元。 Taurus 的竞争力大部分来自于工具及其自动化，而不是来自语言模型本身。 Taurus 表明这种注释可以自动化，这样专家的时间就可以从绘制标签转移到检查标签。

items.title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
items.titleZh: 计算脑成像的生成基础模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00265v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality. In a human-AI collaboration study, BrainGFM assistance yielded a 14% relative improvement in mean radiologist stroke-subtyping accuracy. These findings support generative priors as a reusable foundation for heterogeneous computational brain-imaging applications.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00265v1 公告类型：新
摘要：计算脑成像受到日益多样化的任务与稀缺、异构的临床数据之间不匹配的限制。尽管现有的大脑基础模型转移了预先训练的表示，但它们的知识仍然与模型特定的功能和固定的架构纠缠在一起。本文提出了 BrainGFM，这是一种生成基础模型，通过可重用和可重构的大脑成像先验，将知识转移扩展到表征重用之外。通过对约 130 万个 MRI 和 CT 切片的语料库进行预训练，BrainGFM 支持用于低数据预测学习的任务对齐数据合成和用于图像重建的任务适应后训练。在 48 个下游任务中，BrainGFM 在有限监督下改进了分割和分类，并在异构成像条件下实现了高保真图像增强。涉及两个内部中心和四个外部中心的 4,796 名中风患者的多中心临床验证证明了其适用于围绕中风队列的三项临床相关任务。盲读者评估表明，BrainGFM 生成的 FLAIR 图像在整体诊断质量方面接近获得的 FLAIR。在一项人类与人工智能合作研究中，BrainGFM 的协助使放射科医生中风亚型平均准确度相对提高了 14%。这些发现支持生成先验作为异构计算脑成像应用的可重用基础。

items.title: Automated Theorem Generation in First-Order Logic by Construction from Triangular Standard Contradictions
items.titleZh: 通过三角标准矛盾构造一阶逻辑自动定理生成
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00269v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Automated theorem generation (ATG) seeks to construct new theorems rather than merely prove given conjectures. Existing approaches typically generate candidate statements that require subsequent proof or formal verification. We propose a constructive framework for ATG in first-order logic based on triangular standard contradictions. The method constructs minimally unsatisfiable clause sets from selected first-order literals, then forms theorems by retaining some clauses as premises and taking the negation of one clause, or a conjunction of clauses, as the conclusion. Minimal unsatisfiability ensures that the remaining premises are satisfiable, avoiding trivial inference by explosion, while unsatisfiability of the full set guarantees the resulting entailment. Theorems are therefore correct by construction, without a separate proof procedure for each instance. Extending the previously developed $\Delta_1$ generator, we introduce seven methods, $\Delta_2$--$\Delta_8$, forming a unified family of eight theorem-generation methods. Four generators, $\Delta_1$--$\Delta_4$, have been implemented and released. We also formulate a general $\Delta$-class method encompassing the family. Combinatorial analysis demonstrates the capacity to generate large numbers of distinct theorems systematically. This framework offers a principled foundation for automated theorem discovery and the construction of logically guaranteed knowledge.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00269v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自动定理生成（ATG）旨在构造新定理，而不仅仅是证明给定的猜想。现有方法通常生成需要后续证明或形式验证的候选陈述。我们提出了一个基于三角标准矛盾的一阶逻辑 ATG 的构造框架。该方法从选定的一阶文字构造最小不可满足子句集，然后通过保留一些子句作为前提并以一个子句的否定或子句的合取作为结论来形成定理。最小不可满足性确保了其余前提是可满足的，避免了爆炸引起的琐碎推理，而全套的不可满足性则保证了结果蕴含。因此，定理在构造上是正确的，无需针对每个实例进行单独的证明过程。扩展先前开发的 $\Delta_1$ 生成器，我们引入了 $\Delta_2$--$\Delta_8$ 七种方法，形成了八个定理生成方法的统一系列。四个生成器 $\Delta_1$--$\Delta_4$ 已实现并发布。我们还制定了包含该系列的通用 $\Delta$ 类方法。组合分析证明了系统地生成大量不同定理的能力。该框架为自动定理发现和逻辑保证知识的构建提供了原则基础。
items.author: Yang Xu, Shuwei Chen, Hailin Guo, Jun Liu

items.title: Quantifying Local and Global Fidelity of Nonlinear Embeddings
items.titleZh: 量化非线性嵌入的局部和全局保真度
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00290v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Dimension reduction methods are chosen by a common claim: t-SNE and UMAP preserve local structure, and PCA preserves global structure. Checking it on given data takes local and global scores on one scale and a test that compares two maps. Both scores come from one curve. The locality profile is the chance-corrected share of each point's k nearest neighbors that a map keeps, over all neighborhood sizes. Its value at k = 10 is the local fidelity L, and its mean over 30 to 50 percent of the data is the global fidelity G. We prove that at the midpoint the profile is the agreement on which half of the data is near each point, a rank correlation of the distances. Because L and G are one statistic, two maps can be tested against each other. The LG reversal test applies to any two dimension reduction methods. It decides, with a block-jackknife p-value, whether one map is more local and the other more global, and returns the scale at which to change maps. On 156 maps of twelve datasets with up to 1.38 million points, G agrees with established global scores at 0.89 and 0.96, and 2,000 points estimate it. The test confirms the usual claim on seven datasets. On both retail datasets and both rolled-up manifolds, it finds the neighbor embeddings more global. In an agent memory of one million passages, the two maps cross at 150,000 passages (p = 2.6e-5). Applications span pathology, single cells, supply chains and AI agent memory.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00290v1 公告类型：新
摘要：降维方法的选择有一个共同的主张：t-SNE 和 UMAP 保留局部结构，PCA 保留全局结构。对给定数据进行检查需要在一个尺度上进行局部和全局分数以及比较两个地图的测试。两个分数都来自一条曲线。局部性概况是地图保留的每个点的 k 个最近邻点在所有邻域大小上的机会校正份额。它在 k = 10 处的值是局部保真度 L，其超过 30% 到 50% 的数据的平均值是全局保真度 G。我们证明，在中点处，轮廓是一半数据靠近每个点的一致性，即距离的等级相关性。由于 L 和 G 是一项统计量，因此可以对两张图进行相互测试。 LG反转测试适用于任何二维降维方法。它使用大刀 p 值来决定一张地图是否更局部，而另一张地图是否更全局，并返回更改地图的比例。在 12 个数据集的 156 个地图上，共有 138 万个点，G 与既定的全局分数 0.89 和 0.96 一致，并且有 2,000 个点对其进行了估计。该测试证实了对七个数据集的通常说法。在零售数据集和卷起流形上，它发现邻居嵌入更加全局化。在具有 100 万个段落的智能体记忆中，两个地图在 150,000 个段落处交叉 (p = 2.6e-5)。应用涵盖病理学、单细胞、供应链和人工智能代理内存。

items.title: Output-Aware Block Influence: Jacobian-Lens Weighting for Depth Pruning
items.titleZh: 输出感知块影响：用于深度修剪的雅可比透镜加权
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00015v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Depth pruning removes entire transformer blocks and therefore depends on a reliable criterion for identifying which blocks can be removed. Block Influence (BI) ranks blocks by how minimally they rotate the hidden state. However, local redundancy does not necessarily imply downstream irrelevance. We address this limitation using the Jacobian Lens (J-Lens) neural artifact, a map transporting perturbations at a layer to the final residual stream. At a common sparsity level, pruning scores applying J-Lens transportation to $BI$, what we call $J-BI$, were found to improve post-pruning accuracy by up to 19 points over $BI$ while reducing damage to perplexity for Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, and Gemma-3-12B-IT. We also perform a single-block ablation study and use J-Lens probing to explain why the proposed scores improved performance.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00015v1 公告类型：新
摘要：深度修剪会删除整个变压器块，因此依赖于确定哪些块可以被删除的可靠标准。块影响力 (BI) 根据块旋转隐藏状态的最小程度对块进行排名。然而，本地冗余并不一定意味着下游不相关。我们使用雅可比透镜（J-Lens）神经工件解决了这一限制，该神经工件将一层的扰动传输到最终的残差流。在常见的稀疏性水平上，将 J-Lens 传输应用于 $BI$（我们称之为 $J-BI$）的剪枝分数被发现比 $BI$ 提高了剪枝后的准确性高达 19 个点，同时减少了 Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B-IT 和 Gemma-3-12B-IT 的困惑度损害。我们还进行了单块消融研究，并使用 J-Lens 探测来解释为什么提出的分数提高了性能。

items.title: FB-MOAC: A Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes
items.titleZh: FB-MOAC：一种用于前向-后向马尔可夫决策过程的强化学习算法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00130v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are effective in solving problems that can be modeled as Markov decision processes (MDPs).
 These algorithms primarily target forward MDPs whose dynamics evolve over time from an initial state.
 However, several important problems in different scenarios including stochastic control and network systems exhibit both a forward and a backward dynamics. As a consequence, they cannot be expressed as a standard MDP, thereby calling
 for a novel theory for RL in this context.
 Accordingly, this work introduces the concept of Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes (FB-MDPs)
 for multi-objective problems,
 develops a novel theoretical framework to characterize their optimal solutions,
 and proposes a general forward-backward step-wise template
 that allows to adapt RL algorithms for FB-MDP problems.
 A Forward Backward Multi Objective Actor Critic (FB-MOAC) algorithm is introduced accordingly
 to obtain optimal policies with guaranteed convergence and a competitive rate with respect to standard approaches in RL.
 FB-MOAC is evaluated on diverse use cases in the context of mathematical finance and mobile resource management.
 The obtained results show that FB-MOAC outperforms the state of the art across different metrics,

items.title: Interpretable structural temperature scaling for calibrating graph neural networks and point-cloud segmentation
items.titleZh: 用于校准图神经网络和点云分割的可解释结构温度缩放
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00175v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Graph-aware calibrators make graph neural networks (GNNs) more trustworthy by predicting a temperature for each node, usually with auxiliary networks whose decisions are hard to inspect. We propose Interpretable Structural Temperature Scaling (ISTS), a twelve-parameter linear model that sets each node's temperature from named descriptors of its confidence, neighbourhood and closeness to labelled nodes, so every temperature traces back to descriptor contributions. ISTS preserves predictions, and cross-validated regularisation lets the calibration data decide how far the model departs from temperature scaling (TS). Its explanations are faithful at the level of node groups: on test nodes, ISTS softens groups that a global temperature leaves over-confident and sharpens under-confident ones (Spearman correlation 0.67 over 246 groups). On seven graphs with two backbones and eleven baselines, ISTS has the best average rank in negative log-likelihood (NLL) and Brier score and lowers NLL relative to TS by 1.8%, more than twice the gain of an identically fitted entropy-based temperature. It ranked first again on four held-out graphs under a protocol fixed in advance. From about 100 calibration nodes on, ISTS is a cheap and inspectable choice, and on point-cloud segmentation it significantly improves NLL, Brier score and the ranking of points for rejection.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00175v1 公告类型：新
摘要：图感知校准器通过预测每个节点的温度（通常使用其决策难以检查的辅助网络）使图神经网络（GNN）更值得信赖。我们提出了可解释的结构温度标度（ISTS），这是一个十二参数线性模型，它根据其置信度、邻域和与标记节点的接近度的命名描述符来设置每个节点的温度，因此每个温度都可以追溯到描述符的贡献。 ISTS 保留预测，交叉验证正则化让校准数据决定模型与温度缩放 (TS) 的偏离程度。它的解释在节点组层面上是忠实的：在测试节点上，ISTS 软化了因全球气温而导致过度自信的组，并强化了信心不足的组（246 个组的 Spearman 相关性为 0.67）。在具有两个主干和 11 个基线的七个图表中，ISTS 在负对数似然 (NLL) 和 Brier 评分方面具有最佳平均排名，并且 NLL 相对于 TS 降低了 1.8%，是相同拟合的基于熵的温度增益的两倍多。根据预先确定的协议，它在四个保留的图表中再次排名第一。从大约 100 个校准节点开始，ISTS 是一种廉价且可检查的选择，并且在点云分割上，它显着提高了 NLL、Brier 分数和拒绝点的排名。

items.title: ProLand: A New Infeasible Manifold Optimization Method for LoRA Fine-Tuning
items.titleZh: ProLand：一种新的 LoRA 微调不可行流形优化方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00236v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning but can suffer from redundant basis directions. Constraining the basis factor to the Stiefel manifold addresses this redundancy through orthonormality. Landing methods allow temporarily infeasible iterates to explore a neighborhood of the manifold while progressively restoring orthogonality without per-step retractions. To improve optimization efficiency while retaining this flexibility, we introduce ProLand (Product-space Landing), a retraction-free optimizer that combines coordinated factor updates with Muon-style spectral directions. By designing the updates in the space of the represented weight increment, ProLand separates objective optimization from orthogonality restoration, supporting efficient feasibility recovery. This coordinated construction also enables Muon-style directions to guide objective optimization while preserving that separation. Experiments cover four GLUE validation tasks on DeBERTa-v3-base and seven language benchmarks on Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Moonlight-16B-A3B across multiple adapter ranks. Across these 11 tasks, ProLand achieves the highest average score among the compared methods in every tested encoder and decoder model-rank configuration.

arXiv:2611.00236v1 公告类型：新
摘要：低秩自适应（LoRA）可以实现参数高效的微调，但可能会受到冗余基础方向的影响。将基因子约束为 Stiefel 流形通过正交性解决了这种冗余问题。着陆方法允许暂时不可行的迭代来探索流形的邻域，同时逐步恢复正交性而无需每步撤回。为了提高优化效率，同时保留这种灵活性，我们引入了 ProLand（产品空间着陆），这是一种无回撤优化器，它将协调因子更新与 Muon 式光谱方向相结合。通过在所表示的权重增量空间中设计更新，ProLand 将目标优化与正交恢复分开，支持高效的可行性恢复。这种协调的构造还使得 μ 子式方向能够指导目标优化，同时保持这种分离。实验涵盖 DeBERTa-v3-base 上的四个 GLUE 验证任务以及跨多个适配器等级的 Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B 和 Moonlight-16B-A3B 上的七个语言基准测试。在这 11 项任务中，ProLand 在每个测试的编码器和解码器模型排名配置的比较方法中获得了最高的平均得分。

items.title: IsoAlign: Isoform-Aware DNA-Protein Alignment via Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
items.titleZh: IsoAlign：通过联合嵌入预测架构实现异构体感知 DNA-蛋白质比对
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00241v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning DNA sequence representations, yet existing self-supervised pretraining strategies overlook alternative splicing and underperform compared to specialized models. To address this gap, we introduce IsoAlign, a multimodal framework that grounds genomic pretraining in isoform-aware DNA-protein alignment to learn biologically meaningful representations. IsoAlign aligns transcripts to their corresponding protein isoforms, capturing both coding sequences and broader regulatory contexts, using two Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA): DNA-Protein JEPA (DP-JEPA), which predicts protein representations from DNA using contrastive alignment, and Isoform-Masked JEPA (IM-JEPA), which models relationships among alternative isoforms of the same gene through masked protein prediction. We evaluate the learned DNA representations of these architectures across a multi-metric evaluation suite spanning tasks, including the prediction of pathogenicity, fitness, gene expression, and TF binding. Our results demonstrate that isoform-aware cross-modal alignment using JEPA significantly improves functional representations and downstream performance, establishing a promising direction for GFM pretraining.

arXiv:2611.00241v1 公告类型：新
摘要：基因组基础模型（GFM）已成为学习 DNA 序列表示的强大范例，但现有的自监督预训练策略忽视了选择性剪接，并且与专门模型相比表现不佳。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了 IsoAlign，这是一个多模式框架，它将基因组预训练基于异构体感知的 DNA-蛋白质比对，以学习具有生物学意义的表示。 IsoAlign 使用两种联合嵌入预测架构 (JEPA) 将转录本与其相应的蛋白质同工型进行比对，捕获编码序列和更广泛的监管背景：DNA-蛋白质 JEPA (DP-JEPA)，它使用对比比对来预测 DNA 中的蛋白质表示；Isoform-Masked JEPA (IM-JEPA)，它通过掩蔽蛋白质预测来模拟同一基因的替代同工型之间的关系。我们通过跨任务的多指标评估套件来评估这些架构的学习 DNA 表示，包括预测致病性、适应性、基因表达和 TF 结合。我们的结果表明，使用 JEPA 的异构体感知跨模式比对显着改善了功能表示和下游性能，为 GFM 预训练建立了一个有希望的方向。

items.title: KINDER: Kernel-based Independence for Fair Representation Learning via Prototype-space Erasure
items.titleZh: KINDER：基于内核的独立性，通过原型空间擦除实现公平表示学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00264v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Concept erasure is a prominent approach to achieving fairness in machine learning through the removal of sensitive attributes from learned representations. Prior concept erasure methods typically define debiasing indirectly through the failure of a chosen adversary, probe, or fairness penalty, which makes the target of erasure dependent on a particular decoder family or optimization setup. We introduce KINDER, which directly removes sensitive-attribute information from intermediate representations with respect to a chosen family of prototype functionals, and is compatible with any deep model containing an intermediate feature space, independent of the architecture, task type, or training paradigm. KINDER operates in a random Fourier feature space, where it estimates a sensitive subspace from protected group prototypes and projects representations onto its orthogonal complement. Thus, it forms an explicit representation cleaning mechanism distinct from prior fairness control studies. We conduct extensive experiments across diverse settings and show the effectiveness of KINDER on (i) supervised and self-supervised settings, (ii) classification, regression, and image segmentation tasks, and (iii) diverse data modalities, including visual, textual, and tabular data. Code and trained models are available at: https://github.com/abtinmU/KINDER
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00264v1 公告类型：新
摘要：概念擦除是通过从学习表示中删除敏感属性来实现机器学习公平性的一种重要方法。现有概念擦除方法通常通过所选对手的失败、探测或公平性惩罚来间接定义去偏差，这使得擦除目标依赖于特定的解码器系列或优化设置。我们引入了 KINDER，它直接从选定的原型泛函族的中间表示中删除敏感属性信息，并且与任何包含中间特征空间的深度模型兼容，独立于架构、任务类型或训练范例。 KINDER 在随机傅里叶特征空间中运行，在其中估计受保护群体原型的敏感子空间，并将表示投影到其正交补集上。因此，它形成了一种与之前的公平控制研究不同的显式表示清理机制。我们在不同的设置中进行了广泛的实验，并展示了 KINDER 在以下方面的有效性：(i) 监督和自监督设置，(ii) 分类、回归和图像分割任务，以及 (iii) 不同的数据模式，包括视觉、文本和表格数据。代码和训练模型可在以下位置获取：https://github.com/abtinmU/KINDER

items.title: DELBERT-2: Pretrained Fingerprint Language Models for DEL Protein Binder Prediction
items.titleZh: DELBERT-2：用于 DEL 蛋白质结合剂预测的预训练指纹语言模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00281v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We present DELBERT-2, a pretrained fingerprint language model that converts sparse molecular fingerprints into unified token sequences using a ModernBERT encoder trained with masked language modelling on 2.5M molecules from the AIRCHECK DEL corpus. We evaluate across six targets (WDR91, WDR12, SETDB1, PLCZ1, LRRK2, DCAF7) under three out-of-distribution (OOD) protocols: hierarchical cluster splits probe chemical novelty, library splits test cross-library transfer, and building-block splits assess compositional generalization. DELBERT-2 consistently improves PR-AUC and NDCG@1000 relative to LightGBM ensemble baselines and transformers trained from scratch, with the largest gains in stringent OOD regimes. DELBERT-2 achieves 13.28+/-3.72 enrichment factor at top-100 vs. 12.36+/-3.75 for no-pretraining (p=0.040), representing 7.4% improvement and 13x enrichment over random selection. These results demonstrate that fingerprint-centric self-supervised learning effectively improves hit prioritization under distribution shift, enabling practical DEL virtual screening. Code is available at \hyperlink{https://github.com/GenerativeDrugDiscovery/DELBERT-2}{DELBERT-2}.

items.title: OCELOT: Planetary-Scale Species Distribution Modeling with Satellite Foundation Embeddings
items.titleZh: OCELOT：利用卫星基础嵌入进行行星尺度物种分布建模
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00284v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large-scale repositories of species observations now contain billions of occurrence records from around the world, but these sightings cluster heavily in human-accessible areas. Existing models use only a small fraction of these records and are not evaluated on extrapolating to remote, unvisited regions--where species distribution models can be used as geographic priors to help classify data from camera traps and acoustic recorders. We scale relative occurrence species distribution models by training a multimodal implicit neural representation network called OCELOT that fuses spatial coordinates with satellite foundation embeddings on two orders of magnitude more observations than previous work: 2 billion GBIF records across 100,000 taxa. Scaling to this regime requires co-designing the data pipeline, taxonomic representation, loss formulation, and model architecture: spatiotemporal thinning and sub-linear cell sampling correct for spatial redundancy and observer bias, while an additive taxonomic readout shares representations across species, genera, and families to improve predictions for rare taxa. To evaluate performance in remote areas, we benchmark geographic extrapolation using the NDCG metric on spatial block holdouts up to 600 km. Satellite foundation embeddings improve extrapolation by 51% over coordinate-only models and outperform classical bioclimatic rasters. The resulting model also matches or outperforms existing baselines on established interpolation benchmarks, demonstrating that optimizing for geographic extrapolation does not compromise in-distribution accuracy.

arXiv:2611.00284v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型物种观测资料库现在包含来自世界各地的数十亿条发生记录，但这些目击事件大量集中在人类可到达的区域。现有模型仅使用这些记录的一小部分，并且不会根据外推到偏远、未访问过的区域进行评估——在这些区域，物种分布模型可以用作地理先验，以帮助对来自相机陷阱和声学记录器的数据进行分类。我们通过训练一个名为 OCELOT 的多模态隐式神经表示网络来扩展相对发生物种分布模型，该网络将空间坐标与卫星基础嵌入融合在一起，其观测值比之前的工作多两个数量级：跨越 100,000 个分类单元的 20 亿条 GBIF 记录。扩展到这种机制需要共同设计数据管道、分类表示、损失公式和模型架构：时空细化和亚线性细胞采样纠正空间冗余和观察者偏差，而附加分类读数共享跨物种、属和科的表示，以改进对稀有类群的预测。为了评估偏远地区的性能，我们使用 NDCG 指标对长达 600 公里的空间块保留进行地理外推基准测试。卫星基础嵌入比纯坐标模型将外推法提高了 51%，并且优于经典的生物气候栅格。生成的模型还匹配或优于已建立的插值基准的现有基线，这表明地理外推的优化不会影响分布内的准确性。

items.title: Quantization of Large Models with Weight Outliers and Sparsity
items.titleZh: 具有权重异常值和稀疏性的大型模型的量化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00286v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory burden of large model deployment by casting the high precision trained weights to fewer bits. While this promotes memory-efficient inference, it also incurs quantization error that impairs model performance. To compensate for quantization error, the present contribution decomposes the original trained weights into a quantized matrix, a low-rank component, and a sparse matrix that accounts for outlier rows in the weights. Due to analytical intractability and the discrete structure of the decomposition, a simulated annealing search is employed to explore candidate decompositions while avoiding poor local minima. Numerical tests demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach across a broad suite of large language models, including Llama 3.2 1B, Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, evaluated on natural language generation benchmarks using 4-bit NF4 and FP4 quantizers. The novel method can markedly outperform direct quantization while incurring minimal memory overhead.

arXiv:2611.00286v1 公告类型：新
摘要：训练后量化（PTQ）通过将高精度训练权重转换为更少的位来减少大型模型部署的内存负担。虽然这促进了内存效率的推理，但它也会产生量化误差，从而损害模型性能。为了补偿量化误差，本贡献将原始训练权重分解为量化矩阵、低秩分量和解释权重中异常行的稀疏矩阵。由于分析的困难性和分解的离散结构，采用模拟退火搜索来探索候选分解，同时避免不良的局部最小值。数值测试证明了该方法在一系列大型语言模型（包括 Llama 3.2 1B、Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B 和 Qwen2.5 7B）中的有效性，并使用 4 位 NF4 和 FP4 量化器在自然语言生成基准上进行了评估。这种新颖的方法可以明显优于直接量化，同时产生最小的内存开销。

items.title: A Framework for Task-Agnostic Counterfactual Fairness in Transformers through Activation Steering
items.titleZh: 通过激活引导实现 Transformer 中与任务无关的反事实公平性的框架
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00298v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Bias in transformer-based models is a growing concern as these architectures become more prevalent in automated decision-making systems, such as prediction models for hiring, lending, and clinical treatment recommendation. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is a growing body of work that measures meaningful causal effects of activations on model output by identifying human-interpretable features encoded in model activations. When such features correspond to sensitive attributes, they provide a direct way to quantify the bias those attributes introduce and to causally intervene to mitigate it. However, counterfactual fairness (CF) methods have not been systematically adapted to this setting of intervening on interpretable mechanisms in transformers. We propose a framework, Mechanistic Interpretability for Counterfactual Fairness (MICF), that utilizes MI tools to reformulate CF constraints in terms of transformer activations, unifying former approaches into a single pipeline for fairness analysis in transformers. MICF does not require a prior causal model or specific transformer architecture. We evaluate MICF on real-world tabular data and show that CF can be improved across different prediction tasks.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2611.00298v1 公告类型：新
摘要：随着基于变压器的模型在自动化决策系统中变得越来越普遍，例如招聘、贷款和临床治疗推荐的预测模型，基于变压器的模型的偏差越来越受到关注。机械可解释性 (MI) 是一项不断发展的工作，通过识别模型激活中编码的人类可解释特征来测量激活对模型输出的有意义的因果影响。当这些特征对应于敏感属性时，它们提供了一种直接的方法来量化这些属性引入的偏差并进行因果干预以减轻偏差。然而，反事实公平（CF）方法尚未系统地适应这种对变压器中可解释机制进行干预的环境。我们提出了一个框架，反事实公平的机械可解释性（MICF），它利用 MI 工具重新制定变压器激活方面的 CF 约束，将以前的方法统一到单一管道中，以进行变压器的公平性分析。 MICF 不需要先验因果模型或特定的变压器架构。我们在现实世界的表格数据上评估 MICF，并表明 CF 可以在不同的预测任务中得到改进。
items.author: Joshua Wolff Anderson, Yanshan Wang, Shyam Visweswaran

items.title: RaMMOBO: Random Max-Margin Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
items.titleZh: RaMMOBO：随机最大裕度多目标贝叶斯优化
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00312v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) maximizes $M$ expensive black-box objectives with the goal of approximating the Pareto set, whose objective vectors cannot be improved in one component without sacrificing another. A common quality measure is hypervolume, the volume in objective space dominated by these vectors relative to a reference point. Expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) directly targets this metric and is one-step Bayes-optimal, but its standard computation scales exponentially with $M$, making it prohibitively expensive for many-objective problems. We introduce random max-margin multi-objective Bayesian optimization (RaMMOBO), whose acquisition function lower-bounds EHVI while requiring only linear cost in $M$ to evaluate. RaMMOBO measures the volume of a max-margin box contained in a candidate's hypervolume-improvement region and averages over random reweightings of the objective space, yielding a utility that is strictly Pareto-monotone on hypervolume-improving outcomes. It naturally handles noisy observations and different probabilistic surrogates and supports efficient gradient-based optimization. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, RaMMOBO matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with largest gains at higher $M$, with acquisition optimization up to two orders of magnitude faster than qLogNEHVI. Our implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rammobo.

items.title: Cyber-physical attack detection approaches in the wide-area measurement system
items.titleZh: 广域测量系统中的网络物理攻击检测方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00316v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Improving situational awareness within the Smart Grid is an effective preventive measure to detect potential anomalies, and avoid their adverse consequences. A wide area measurement system (WAMS) based Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) can assist in improving visibility within the grid by collecting relevant measurements including magnitude, phase angle, frequency, voltage, and current, with a precise GPS-based timestamp. So far, there are more than 2500 PMUs deployed in the North American power grid, where each of which generates between 30 and 60 samples/s, roughly 1.5 TB/month of streamed data. Thus, processing such large PMU streams requires expensive computational resources and faster algorithms. This paper provides state-of-the-art cyber and physical anomalies in the WAMS and analyses their impact on the integrity and availability of the system. Next, it investigates the current anomaly detection approach in historical and streaming PMU data, including conventional machine learning and hybrid approaches, and assesses their advantages and main drawbacks. Lastly, it sheds light on the importance of handling missing PMU data and concept drifts.

items.title: C3: Speech-Guided KV Retrieval for Long-Context SpeechLLM Inference
items.titleZh: C3：用于长上下文语音LLM 推理的语音引导 KV 检索
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00333v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Speech language models encode audio at a much higher rate than text, causing the KV cache to dominate the memory, bandwidth, and decoding cost of long-form generation. KV retrieval can reduce per-step access by attending to only a query-dependent subset of the cache, but existing methods are designed primarily for text and do not account for the structure of audio attention. We first show that retrieval errors may compound autoregressively into generation drift. We then analyze full audio attention during long-form generation and identify three properties relevant to retrieval: unequal attention concentration across query heads, non-contiguous audio support, and temporal continuity across decoding steps. Guided by these observations, we propose $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete), which organizes audio KVs in a hierarchical key-space index, lets query heads sharing a KV head compete for a common retrieval budget, and adaptively reallocates retrieval resolution through paired split-merge updates. Across long-form speech recognition, translation, and summarization on four SpeechLLMs, $C^3$ achieves the strongest overall performance among retrieval methods under comparable final-KV access budgets, with particularly large gains in the tight-budget regime, while improving long-context decoding efficiency and accelerator-memory scaling.

arXiv:2611.00333v1 公告类型：新
摘要：语音语言模型以比文本高得多的速率对音频进行编码，导致 KV 缓存主导长格式生成的内存、带宽和解码成本。 KV 检索可以通过仅关注缓存的查询相关子集来减少每步访问，但现有方法主要针对文本设计，不考虑音频关注的结构。我们首先表明检索错误可能会自回归复合为生成漂移。然后，我们分析长格式生成过程中的完整音频注意力，并确定与检索相关的三个属性：查询头之间的注意力集中程度不同、不连续的音频支持以及解码步骤之间的时间连续性。在这些观察的指导下，我们提出 $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete)，它将音频 KV 组织在分层键空间索引中，让共享 KV 头的查询头竞争公共检索预算，并通过成对的拆分合并更新自适应地重新分配检索分辨率。在四个 SpeechLLM 上的长格式语音识别、翻译和摘要中，$C^3$ 在可比较的最终 KV 访问预算下实现了检索方法中最强的整体性能，在预算紧张的情况下获得了特别大的收益，同时提高了长上下文解码效率和加速器内存扩展。

items.title: Decomposing Irregular Time Series into Interpretable Temporal Patterns with Mixture-of-Experts
items.titleZh: 通过混合专家将不规则时间序列分解为可解释的时间模式
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00337v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Irregularly-spaced sequential data, such as transaction logs, encode multi-scale temporal structure that is critical for prediction but difficult to recover explicitly with standard sequence models, which often trade interpretability for performance. We introduce MoTIF, an interpretable framework using mixture-of-experts (MoE) attention to decompose irregular time series into temporal patterns spanning minute-to-year scales. Each expert is trained via temporal alignment that induces attention specialization to a designated cyclical or within-range pattern, with label-free routing supervision that learns to activate the correct expert from patterns present in the data. On synthetic data with known temporal structure, MoTIF recovers correct routing well above chance (0.389/0.829 for range/cyclical patterns vs. 0.091 random) and outperforms all baselines, including a standard transformer and an unspecialized MoE, on next-value prediction. On a public credit card transaction dataset, MoTIF achieves higher macro-F1 than all baselines for next-amount prediction. Its learned routing reveals structure a black-box model cannot: transactions are governed primarily by intraday and short-interval rhythms, while fraudulent transactions show bursty, calendar-agnostic timing versus the steadier periodicity of legitimate ones. On downstream fraud detection, MoTIF matches standard transformer and MoE baselines and clearly outperforms recent sequential recommendation models used as embedding baselines. These results show that decomposing temporal structure into interpretable, expert-specific patterns need not sacrifice predictive accuracy, offering a practical route to sequence models that are both accurate and auditable in high-stakes settings. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MoTIF-82E4.

items.title: DEPLOY-RL: Active Boundary Discovery and Conservative Certification for Deployable Reinforcement Learning in Safety-Critical Continuous Processes
items.titleZh: DEPLOY-RL：安全关键连续过程中可部署强化学习的主动边界发现和保守认证
items.summary:
arXiv:2611.00342v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies often outperform classical controllers in simulation, yet rarely reach production in safety-critical processes. The barrier is that there is no principled way to answer "Is this policy safe to deploy?" with statistical guarantees. We introduce DEPLOY-RL, a post-training certification framework built on one key insight: deployment certification requires discovering where failures occur (boundary discovery), not measuring how much everywhere (uniform reconstruction). Our contributions: (1) a contract-coupled acquisition function that concentrates sampling on certification-critical boundaries, achieving approximately 2x sample efficiency with a semi-empirical ambiguity reduction bound (domain-calibrated convergence guarantee); (2) conformal risk control providing finite-sample false-go guarantees ( 85% coverage among 14 baselines under our evaluation protocol.
